description: A contemporary Scandinavian-influenced kitchen photographed at standing eye-level with a normal lens in a three-quarter corner composition. The camera looks diagonally across the kitchen island toward the wall of perimeter cabinetry, revealing both the island surface and the full back wall with appliances. Dark walnut exposed ceiling beams run across the upper portion of the frame against a white plastered ceiling, adding warmth and natural texture to the otherwise cool, minimal space. The perimeter cabinetry is flat-panel in soft warm greige with slim chrome bar pulls, and the backsplash features handmade square ceramic tiles in a pale sandy tone that catches warm under-cabinet illumination — a strip of amber glow running along the counter edge and bathing the tile surface from below. A stainless double oven column is recessed into the far wall to the right of the backsplash. The large island has a matte quartz or concrete countertop in light warm grey with a black undermount sink and a polished chrome arc gooseneck faucet. The island cabinetry is painted white below with a light-oak-veneer lower section blending into the perimeter cabinetry tone. A shallow wooden bowl holding ripe bananas rests on the island counter as the sole decorative object. Natural daylight filters in from a slim window at the right edge of the frame. The palette is quiet and cohesive — greige, white, warm oak, and chrome with walnut beam accents.
